evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Worry and problem entanglement
criteria.definition: Recurrent worry about current concerns or completed events, including getting caught up in problems.
criteria.high_evidence: Repeatedly worries, dwells on problems, or worries after an event has already happened.
criteria.low_evidence: Can put concerns aside and does not continue worrying about completed events.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Thinking through an actionable problem is not itself worry. N3 sadness and N6 inability to cope are insufficient without anxious preoccupation; shared worry/entanglement wording counts once.

criteria.label: Fear and worst-outcome anticipation
criteria.definition: Fear across ordinary situations and apprehension that the worst may happen.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels afraid of many things or anticipates the worst absent a specific decisive warning.
criteria.low_evidence: Reports little fear across ordinary uncertainties and does not tend to expect the worst.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Fear in a genuinely dangerous one-off situation alone does not establish a habitual pole. Calm behavior does not rule out explicitly described internal fear.

criteria.label: Readiness to become stressed or disturbed
criteria.definition: Being easily stressed, bothered or disturbed by events.
criteria.high_evidence: Small events readily cause stress, tension or disturbance.
criteria.low_evidence: Ordinary events rarely bother or disturb the person.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. N2 anger is not automatically anxiety. N6 panic/overwhelm alone is not this readiness unless stress/disturbance is stated. Allocate an identical tension span only once.

criteria.label: Usual relaxation and adaptation
criteria.definition: Usual relaxation and ease of adapting to new situations, scored in the anxiety direction.
criteria.high_evidence: Usually remains tense or has difficulty feeling settled in a changed ordinary situation.
criteria.low_evidence: Is relaxed much of the time and adapts readily to new situations.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Low interest in novelty is O4 and is not necessarily anxious difficulty adapting. Resting opportunity alone does not establish relaxation; physical illness or a transient dangerous context alone is ambiguous.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent portrayed anxiety, difficulty, social awkwardness or antagonism is distinct from actual task/format failure.
One-off constraints alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence remains assessable.

Anxious worry, apprehension and readiness to be disturbed define the target. Preserve both retrospective worry and adapting to new situations. This is not a broad distress, depression or helpless-coping proxy.
Score literal item-grounded content rather than politeness, moral worth, verbosity or apparent helpfulness.
